text:
Lena (Product): quick sync on catalog compare — two focuses: make pinning discoverable and reduce accidental misclicks with badges.
Priya (Design): thinking header-level primary pin toggle + small per-row pin. header shows count of pinned versions as a chip. also compact toolbar variant to group filters into overflow when space is tight.
Omar (Eng): header pin is straightforward; chip state persisted in sessionStorage initially. compact toolbar: implement overflow pill that reveals extra chips in a menu. watch mobile height.
Ava (A11y): header pin should be aria-pressed and announce changes via aria-live. overflow menu must be role=menu with menuitemcheckbox for filters. ensure tab order lands on toolbar before row checkboxes.
Riley (Research): in tests users reached header for pin first. per-row pin used only to confirm. suggest we A/B header-first vs row-first for 2 weeks and track pin_success_rate.
Priya (Design): badge contrast: darken green to #2b9b45 and ensure tooltips show full numeric details on hover/focus. shorten in-row text to "latency — ok" to save space.
Omar (Eng): will add aria-labels to badges with full text. small CSS tweak for hit targets: use padding with negative margins to avoid layout shifts.
preview-bot: review app at https://staging.redwood.company/review/7123 — header-pin + compact-toolbar behind flag catalog_pin_toolbar.
Lena (Product): thanks team. action items: design mocks for header chip + overflow, eng prototype on feature flag, a11y checklist items, and a short research script for the A/B.
Priya (Design): will drop mocks and token values by tomorrow.
Omar (Eng): will branch and demo mid-week.
Ava (A11y): I'll run axe on the preview and share results.
Lena (Product): great - add analytics event 'catalog.pin_toggled' and 'catalog.toolbar_overflow_opened'. thank you!
